post.summary: Collect the environment logs and send them to support
post.description: Collects the logs of every container and the diagnostics of this environment into an archive and uploads it to the MOLO17 support portal. With `voucher` (GSV-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, from the support ticket) the archive goes straight into that ticket through the support portal: the voucher is checked before collecting, nothing falls back to WebDAV, FTP or the legacy script, and the archive is deleted only once the portal verified its size (otherwise `archivePath` says where it stayed). Without a voucher the legacy path runs: `ticketId` (GSSD-1234, 1234 or #1234) and `email`, uploaded via WebDAV, then FTP, then the legacy script. `voucher` cannot be combined with `ticketId` or `email`. With `localOnly` the archive stays on this host and every credential is ignored. The portal address can be overridden with GLUESYNC_SUPPORT_API_URL; requests go through PROXY_HTTPS / PROXY_HTTP when set. Failures of the portal upload carry a `code`: voucher_format, voucher_invalid, voucher_expired, file_too_large (with maxBytes) answer 400; rate_limited answers 429; portal_unreachable answers 502; a body that mixes the voucher with ticketId or email answers 400 validation.

voucher.description: Support voucher of the ticket (GSV-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX): uploads the archive to the support portal. Cannot be combined with ticketId or email

ticketId.description: Legacy upload only: ticket key in the issue tracker (GSSD-1234, 1234 or #1234)

email.description: Legacy upload only: email of the user sending the logs

localOnly.description: If true, collects and archives logs locally without credential validation or upload

archivePath.description: Where the archive stayed: local-only mode, or an upload the portal could not verify

verified.description: The portal holds as many bytes as were sent; the local archive is deleted only then
